title: Microsoft Teams Exporter Configuration
description: Teams incoming webhooks, one per channel this exporter can post to.

teams.title: Microsoft Teams
teams.description: Webhook targets. A Teams webhook URL posts to exactly one channel.

webhooks.title: Channel Webhooks
webhooks.description: One entry per channel. The Teams Message action names a channel and this exporter posts to the matching webhook.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Label the Teams Message action selects by; match it to the channel this webhook posts to. Matching ignores case.

url.title: Webhook URL
url.description: Teams Incoming Webhook / Power Automate Workflow URL for this channel; must be http(s). Wire this to a secret.
